MT940 / MultiCash Statement Format — Shared Parser

The SWIFT MT940 statement reader with the Czech layout of field :86:, used by the MT940 statement import.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresbase
Extended byaccount_statement_import_mt940
This module is part of a family documented in one place. The full guide: account_statement_import_mt940

Reads SWIFT MT940 statements as Czech banks deliver them through MultiCash, X-business and Business 24, including the ?NN subfields of field :86: that carry VS/KS/SS and the counterparty, recognising each symbol by its prefix rather than its position.

It has no screen and no settings. It is installed as a dependency of account_statement_import_mt940.
